added_lines: the wedding feast is a picture of god's desire to invite his people to the joy of his kingdom, on the condition that they obey his will. but the israelites disobey god by doing evil and practicing idolatry. god sends prophets to denounce the people's faithlessness and acts of injustice and then to invite them to repentance. in time, with god's coming, god's invitation is opened also to those who are not'god's people' the pagans, rejoice that they are invited and they accept jesus and his message. but it is not enough to accept the invitation. one should prove oneself worthy of the banquet by being properly attired, by putting in the goodwill and effort to live the message of jesus. we gather to celebrate the eucharist, which is to be a celebration in hope, joy and love as a foretaste of the heavenly banquet. to take part in it is a grace and a privilege. but we must wear the wedding garment of sinlessness and obedience to god's will. many before us have been called to the feast but failed to stay. fr. george fr. kolwani parish office : 01 6287 406 01 6287 448 01 6757 311 parish shop: 01 6287 499 - mon – fri: 10.30am – 12.30pm our annual blessing of the graves will take place on sun, 1st nov: after 10.30am mass in newtown 2pm in st. joseph’s 3pm in cloncurry collections will be taken up at all cemeteries to help with the upkeep and maintenance of all the cemeteries. thank you for your continued support. we remember in our prayers eamonn hopkins (rip), donadea, whose funeral took place on monday last. we also ask prayers for thomas ryan (rip), london/kilcock who was buried in st. joseph’s on monday last. may they rest in peace. applications for enrolment into st. joseph’s ns for 2027 are now being accepted until fri, 23rd oct. see website for further details.

leighlin parish newsletter 18th october 2026 29th sunday in ordinary time world mission sunday 18th october: “one in christ, united in mission ”. it is world mission sunday, a day when our entire church family comes together for a truly incredible celebration of solidarity. today, every single church around the world shares what they can, so that the vital work of the church and our missionaries can continue. through your extra generosity, you are offering much needed financial help to missionaries who dedicate their lives to those who are suffering and neglected. right now , missionaries desperately need your help. in many poorer parishes in africa, asia, and latin america missionaries are serving on the front line. they already do so much, walking hand-in-hand with marginalized communities, long before and after any emergency. you can show missionaries you care by supporting world mission sunday. your prayers and generosity will change lives. from all the missionaries your kindness supports, thank you for digging deeper today. call missio ireland (01)4972035 or log onto www .mission.ie to donate. contact details: fr pat hennessy
